    # Two matching patterned panels are separated by a blank band. Reconcile

    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]

            groups.append([r])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(r)
    if len(groups) < 2:
        return out
    a, b = groups[0], groups[-1]
    h = min(len(a), len(b))
    # Align panels at their top edges; mark absences in less-dense panel.
    ca = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in a for c in range(len(grid[0])))
    cb = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in b for c in range(len(grid[0])))
    sparse, dense = (a, b) if ca < cb else (b, a)
